description.value: Northern Rockies Lodge is a full-service lakeside resort perched on Muncho Lake at Mile 462 of the Alaska Highway, roughly halfway between Fort St. John and Whitehorse—making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the Alcan. The property spans hotel rooms, motel units, cozy cabins, lakeshore chalets, and an RV park, all complemented by a licensed dining room, lounge, sauna, and on-site gas station. Its proximity to Liard Hot Springs and the Muskwa-Kechika backcountry gives tired touring cyclists both practical services and a genuinely spectacular setting in the northern Rockies.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed information about Northern Rockies Lodge. The front page and subpages confirm a year-round, full-service resort at Mile 462 Alaska Highway, Muncho Lake, BC, with hotel rooms, cabins, chalets, RV sites, a licensed dining room, lounge, sauna, and gas station. WiFi is explicitly confirmed for RV guests ('30 amp, water and WIFI') and laundry facilities are listed on the RV park page; no mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedures, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone or address tags; phone and address sourced entirely from website.
Website footer shows copyright 2020, but events page lists 2026 and 2027 events, confirming the business is currently active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, year-round, publicly accessible resort on the Alaska Highway with multiple accommodation types—an obvious and valuable stop for touring cyclists on the Alcan.
